why: rclc registers only four transitions (configure/activate/deactivate/cleanup); we register all six, matching rclcpp's `LifecycleNodeInterface`. An embedded node needs `on_shutdown` most of all -- it is where a device parks an actuator before the image stops. The `Option_LifecycleCallbackFnCtx` defect that this row used to carry is FIXED (issue 0792): the `cb` parameter is now the named, nullable `rclc_lifecycle_callback_t` typedef.
